body.x: Ninewatt (CEO Youngrok Kim) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition, held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time).

Ninewatt is an energy management platform that analyzes electricity usage patterns and tariff structures based on building energy data, then presents actionable cost-saving recommendations. Rather than simply displaying consumption levels, its solution integrates and analyzes multiple factors, including contracted power, peak load, tariff plans, and equipment operating methods, to deliver the insights needed to reduce electricity costs.

Recently, the company has advanced its AI-based analysis technology and expanded its functionality into an “Energy Adviser” that allows building managers to manage energy with minimal effort. By using a mechanism that learns from historical and real-time data, Ninewatt detects abnormal usage patterns and provides situation-specific operational guidance, supplying its solution to public institutions, private buildings, and industrial facilities.

At CES 2026, Ninewatt introduced “Opti,” a CES Innovation Award–winning solution described as “building energy intelligence.” Opti connects to smart meter data at 15-minute intervals without requiring additional hardware or system establishment, analyzes power usage patterns, and evaluates energy cost-reduction opportunities, peak load-shifting effects, and the impact of installing solar power and energy storage systems.

Opti applies large-language-model–based conversational energy intelligence to deliver high usability. For example, when a user asks a chatbot in natural language about expected savings from adjusting peak-time usage, the system immediately provides personalized simulation results. This functionality enables even non-specialists to access complex energy insights.

Opti has also gained recognition for delivering high-precision simulation performance without specialized hardware. By leveraging existing smart meter data, climate and environmental information, tariff structures, and building load characteristics, the platform predicts future energy consumption and evaluates the effectiveness of photovoltaic and energy storage system investments. With a software-centric design that combines a proprietary simulation engine and an LLM, Opti ensures rapid deployment, cost efficiency, and seamless integration even with aging infrastructure.

In addition, its modular API design allows rapid optimization across different regulatory environments and utility structures, enabling easy deployment across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By providing continuous, dynamic analysis rather than one-time reports, Opti maximizes accessibility to energy intelligence. A dynamic dashboard visualizes real-time energy flows, cost forecasts, and simulation results in an intuitive format aligned with user needs.

A Ninewatt official said, “Opti, refined through on-site demonstrations at more than 100 industrial sites and real user feedback, is evolving beyond a simple monitoring tool into an intelligent energy advisor accessible to anyone.” The official added, “Starting with this CES, we plan to expand sales channels in Japan and the United States, our current key export markets, while accelerating entry into Europe and Southeast Asia.” The official continued, “In the long term, our goal is to expand into more countries and regions and grow into a global SaaS platform.”

The Incheon Metropolitan City Government and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority formed the “INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion” at LVCC North Hall during CES 2026, presenting Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as it evolves beyond a smart city into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs, including Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Awards Showcase, the pavilion supported the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES, including 10 companies exhibiting at the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion. In particular, 14 companies won 17 CES Innovation Awards, marking the largest achievement to date and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovative enterprises.
